# 60.00 USD leaving the bank against two CAD splits, on the bill side.
#
# The bill's version of the shape a grouped payment cannot divide. The entry
# is quoted in CAD because `Assets:Due From Director` is CAD, and the 83.40
# it holds is split across two lines of 41.70 — neither of which says
# anything about the settlement.
#
# What this fixture produces: a CAD transaction, bank −60.00 USD valued
# −83.40 CAD against two `Assets:Due From Director` splits of +41.70 each,
# none of them in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
